paite: Saul inkuante leh David inkuante sawtpi akidou ua; David in hatlam amanoh a, Saul inkuante'n hat louh lam amanoh uhi.
heading: David Tapate

paite: David in Hebron ah tapate anei a, ata masapen, Amnon, Jezreel mi Ahinoam lak a ahi.
Azom Kileab, Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail lak a ahi. Athumna Absalom, Geshur kumpipa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa ahi.
Alina Adonijah, Haggith tapa ahi a; angana Shephatiah, Abital tapa.
Agukna Ithream, David zi Eglah lak a ahi. Hiai teng David tapa Hebron a piangte ahi uh.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul inkuante leh David inkuante akidou sung un Saul inkuante a ding in Abner akihatsak semsem hi.
heading: David Lam Ah Abner Ahong Pang

paite: Saul in mei anei a, amin Rizpah ahi. Amah Aiah tanu ahi. Ishboshet in Abner kiang ah, "Bangziak a ka pa mei kithuahpih na hia?" achi hi.

Ishboshet thugen in Abner ahehsak mahmah hi. Judahte ui lutang leltak ka hi a hia? Tuni tan in na pa Saul inkuante leh a-unaute leh alawmte tung ah zahngaihna ka hihlang a, David khut ah ka hon pe kei hi. Hinapi a nang hiai numei tung a khial a na hon ngoh mawk!
Pathian in Abner alohloh in loh henla, huai sang a sezaw in leng. David kiang a TOUPA akichiam bang a, huchibang ngei atung a ka hih keileh.
Saul inkuante lak a pan agam laksak ding, Israel leh Judahte tung a Dan a pan a Beer-sheba tan a David laltutphah tunding ding.
Huchi in ama'n Abner alau mahmah ziak in dawn himhim leng adawng thei kei hi.

Abner in amah sik in David kiang ah mi asawl a, "Hiai gam kua a ahia? Ka kiang ah thu khung in. Huchi in ngai in, Israel mi tengteng na lam a pang ding in ka khut nang lam ah apang ding," chi in ava gensak hi.

Ama'n, "Hi hen. Na kiang ah thu ka khung ding. Himahleh na tung ah thil khat ka hon phut hi. Huai tuh hiai ahi. Hong mu ding a na hong pai chiang in Saul tanu Mikal na hon pi phot keileh ka mel na mu thei kei ding," achi hi.
David in Saul tapa Ishboshet kiang ah, "Philistia mite zekvun zakhat a ka leisa, ka zi Mikal hon pia in," chi ding in mi asawl hi.
Ishboshet in mi asawl a, apasal Laish tapa Paltiel mahmah a pan apita hi.
Apasal in kap kawm in Bahurim tan anung azui zel hi. Abner in akiang ah, "Pai in, kik nawn in," achi hi. Huchi in akik nawnta hi.
Abner in Israel upate ahoupih a, "Tuma siah David na kumpipa ding un na zong uh.
Tu in na kumpipa un bawl un. TOUPA'N David tungtang thu ah, ka sikha David khut in ka mi Israelte Philistia mite khut a pan leh amelma teng khut a pan ka hunkhe ding ana chi," achi hi.
Abner in Benjamin mite bil a zak in agen hi. Israel mite leh Benjamin inkuan tengteng in hoih asak bangbang un Hebron a David bil a zak dia gen ding in Abner ahoh hi.
Abner leh amite sawmnih Hebron a David kiang ah apai uhi. David in Abner leh akiang a mi sawmnihte a ding in ankuang alui hi.

Abner in David kiang ah, "Ka thou ding a, na kiang a thu akhuntheihna ding un leh na deihthusam bangtak a vai na hawmtheihna ding in Israel mi tengteng ka toupa kiang a kaikhawm ding in ka kuan ding,” achi hi. David in Abner asawlkhia a, lungmuangtak in akuanta hi.

Ngai in, David mite leh Joab galdou zou ahong tung ua, gallak tampi ahon pua uh. Himahleh Abner bel Hebron a David kiang ah ana om nawn kei hi. Ana paikiksak khinta a, amah leng lungmuangtak in ana paita hi.
heading: Abner Thah In A-om

paite: Joab leh akiang a mipi tengteng ahong tun un, Ner tapa Abner kumpipa kiang ah ahoh hi. Ama'n ana paisak nawn khin a, "Lungmuangtak in apai nawnta," chi in Joab ahilh uhi.
Kumpipa kiang ah Joab ahoh a, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia oi? Ngai in, Abner na kiang ah ahong a, bangziak a paimangsak a, apaimang vengveng mawk?
Ner tapa Abner na thei a, nang hong khem ding a na pawt lam leh na lut lam leh na thilhih peuhmah theih tum a hong pai ahi," achi hi.
David kiang a pan Joab ahong pawtkhiak in Abner delh ding in mi asawl hi. Sirah a tuileh a pan ava pikik uh. Himahleh David in athei kei hi.
Hebron a Abner ahong tun in Joab in sim houpih ding in kulh kongpi ah apituam hi. A-unaupa Asahel sisan pawt thukna ding in anakguh ngana nuaitak ah adawt a, huchi in asita hi.
Anung a David in azak in, "Ner tapa Abner sisan thu ah kei mahleh ka gam TOUPA mitmuh in tangtawn in ka siang uh.

Joab lutung ah kia henla; apa inkote tengteng tung ah toh. Joab inkote lak ah meima sia vei hiam, phak natna nei hiam, chiangkhun ngai a pai hiam, namsau a si hiam, kial thuak hiam kitatlak lou in hong om hen," achi hi.
Huchi in a-unaupa uh Asahel Gibeon a kidouna a athah ziak in Joab leh a-unau Abishai in Abner athat uhi.
David in Joab leh akiang a mi om tengteng kiang ah, "Na puante uh botkek unla, sai-ip puan silh unla, Abner suun in ama ah pai un," achi hi. David in leng siluang azui hi.
heading: Abner Vui In A-om

paite: Hebron ah Abner avui ua, kumpipa'n a-aw suakkhesak in Abner han ah akap a, mipi tengteng leng akap uhi.
Kumpipa'n Abner akah a: "Abner, mihai sih in asi dia hia?
Na khut hen ahi kei a, na khete leng sikkol butsak ahi sam kei. Migiloute ma a mi apuk bang a na puk maizen? achi hi." Mi tengteng in akah nawn uhi.

Huchi in sun ahih lai in mi tengteng David an nesak ding in ahong pai uh. Himahleh David in, "Nitum ma a an nek hiam, thil dang hiam leng ka nekleh Pathian in alohloh hon loh hen; huai sang a sezaw in leng," chi in akichiam hi.
Mi tengteng in huai atheih un akipak mahmah uh. Kumpipa thilhih peuhmah in mite akipaksak hi.
Mi tengteng leh Israel mi tengteng in huai ni in Ner tapa Abner thah ahih kumpipa thu ahi kei chih athei uhi.
Kumpipa'n mite kiang ah, "Tuni in Israel milian, mithupitak asi, chih thei lou na hi uh maw?
Kumpipa dia thaunilh himah leng, tuni in ka hat kei hi. Hiai Zeruiah tapate kei a ding in athuakhak lua uh. TOUPA'N thil hoih lou hihmi agitlouh dungzui zel in thuk hen," achi hi.
